summary: Convert sealed evaluation evidence into bounded, reviewable improvement candidates without self-certification or automatic mutation.
enforcement: Require discriminating positive and negative or boundary controls for component health. Preserve evaluation lineage and visibility. Treat generated cases, judges, and production-demand signals as provisional until independently grounded. Record multi-cause attribution with uncertainty, propose rather than apply remediation, pass contamination and held-out checks, require admission before mutation, independently verify outcomes, and gate on every required assurance axis rather than an average alone.
